armyRule.body:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.
▪ Become **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, as stated in other rules.

While a unit is **riled up**:
▪ That unit has 5+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.
▪ That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
▪ When that unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

**War Cry (Once per battle, per army):** At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the **Waaagh!** ability are **riled up** until the end of the next turn.

### Da Boss
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Unstable energies
ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level]** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic ability]** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit's **psyker level**.

**Example:** In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1** abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make: some Orks rules allow a unit to make a **pulse jet move**, as described below. (The **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** the codex also lists is a core move type — see Core Rules, 18.06.)

**Pulse Jet Move**
◈ MAXIMUM DISTANCE | **Pulse roll** + 18"
◈ ELIGIBLE IF | As stated in the rule allowing this **move type**.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit moves as described in Moving (Core Rules, 03).
◈ BEFORE MOVING | Make a **pulse roll** by rolling one D6.
◈ WHILE MOVING
▪ Ignore all vertical distance for the purposes of how far your unit has moved.
▪ Your unit can move through all types of model.
▪ Your unit can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of **[gloss:terrain-feature:terrain feature]**.
◈ AFTER MOVING
▪ Your unit must be **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
▪ Until the end of the turn, your unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** or **[gloss:action:start an action]**.
▪ Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
armyRule.flavor: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.
armyRule.name: Waaagh!

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters

stratagems.flavor: Should attempts to obliterate the Beast Snaggas from afar fail, it is often the foe’s last mistake as the hunters turn their baleful attention on them.
stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

enhancements.flavor: This Mek’s extra bioniks help him keep up with his Kans.
enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta

▪ This model has [core:Lone Operative].

▪ **3-4:** +2 **[gloss:strength:S]**

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage

stratagems.flavor: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis – and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz – it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.
stratagems.name: Dread Power

ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only.
▪ This unit has CHARACTER.
▪ When this unit ends an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6" of this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]** until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon (Upgrade)

▪ While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
rule.flavor: When attacking en masse, crazed and excitable Flyboyz unleash torrential quantities of dakka.
rule.name: Skyborne Loons

stratagems.flavor: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.
stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion

stratagems.name: Scarper!

Friendly ORKS PSYKER models have the following **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic abilities]**:

▪ Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 from that **battle-shock roll** for every 10 models in this unit.

**Visions of Violence (psychic level 1):** At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not **battle-shocked**, you can make a **psychic roll** for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
▪ On a 1, this unit is **battle-shocked**.

armyRule.body:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.
▪ Become **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, as stated in other rules.

While a unit is **riled up**:
▪ That unit has 5+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.
▪ That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
▪ When that unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

**War Cry (Once per battle, per army):** At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the **Waaagh!** ability are **riled up** until the end of the next turn.

### Da Boss
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Unstable energies
ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level]** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic ability]** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit's **psyker level**.

**Example:** In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1** abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make: some Orks rules allow a unit to make a **pulse jet move**, as described below. (The **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** the codex also lists is a core move type — see Core Rules, 18.06.)

**Pulse Jet Move**
◈ MAXIMUM DISTANCE | **Pulse roll** + 18"
◈ ELIGIBLE IF | As stated in the rule allowing this **move type**.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit moves as described in Moving (Core Rules, 03).
◈ BEFORE MOVING | Make a **pulse roll** by rolling one D6.
◈ WHILE MOVING
▪ Ignore all vertical distance for the purposes of how far your unit has moved.
▪ Your unit can move through all types of model.
▪ Your unit can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of **[gloss:terrain-feature:terrain feature]**.
◈ AFTER MOVING
▪ Your unit must be **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
▪ Until the end of the turn, your unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** or **[gloss:action:start an action]**.
▪ Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
armyRule.flavor: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

▪ +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
▪ 5+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.
enhancements.flavor: It is said this Ork bleeds Squig oil and his growl is that of a revving engine. Certainly any vehicle he rides to war seems to respond powerfully to his presence.
enhancements.name: Blitzboss

enhancements.body: WARBOSS model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:damage-roll:D]**.
enhancements.flavor: What tactics occasionally pop into this Ork’s head revolve purely around how hard he needs to wallop his enemies to send their skulls flying.
enhancements.name: Brutal But Kunnin’

enhancements.body: WARBOSS model only. This model has the following weapon:
enhancements.flavor: Firing gold-plated teef as its unconventional ammunition, da Gobshot Thunderbuss proclaims its owner’s obscene wealth even as it sweeps away swathes of enemies.
enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss

enhancements.body:
WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, this unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6".
▪ If this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, you can re-roll that D6.
enhancements.flavor: Thanks to the tangle of stolen empyric electrodes wired into this helmet, a powerful Ork wearing it is capable of thinking a little further ahead than his next fight.
enhancements.name: Morgog’s Finkin’ Cap

enhancements.body: WARBOSS model only. This model can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
enhancements.flavor: This unstoppable brute is an engine of destruction whose welts of scars have been won in countless victories.
enhancements.name: Proper Killy

enhancements.body:
INFANTRY WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per army)At the end of a phase in which this model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was **destroyed**, **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, with 3 wounds remaining.
enhancements.flavor: With a lifetime of picking fights with the galaxy’s most lethal fighters behind him, and a gnarled hide thicker than Battlewagon armour, this Ork has survived blows that would fell an Ambull.
enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth

rule.body:
When a friendly WARBOSS model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if this unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to the roll if your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**:
▪ On a 3+, do not remove this WARBOSS model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this WARBOSS model is removed from the battlefield.
rule.flavor: The largest Orks have risen to their position through strength, savagery and being harder than anyone else.
rule.name: ’Ard as Nails

enhancements.body: MEGA ARMOUR model only. This unit (excluding VEHICLE units) has [core:Deep Strike].
enhancements.flavor: This Ork has bullied his way into possession of a mostly functional tellyporta pad, and has so far survived being thrown through the Warp towards the best fights.
enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss

enhancements.body:
NOBZ unit only. When an enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**:
▪ That enemy unit must select the **[gloss:desperate-escape:desperate escape]** mode.
▪ If this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, that enemy unit has -1 to the **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]** made for that **desperate escape**.
enhancements.flavor: Any snivelling gitz attempting to back away from a good fight with these arrogant Nobz get a good kicking to see them on their way.
enhancements.name: Wimp-kickaz (Upgrade)

rule.body: Friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
rule.flavor: Nobz have a position of dominance to maintain, and do so in vicious eruptions of violence.
rule.name: Displays of Savagery

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than your unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

extraCost.body: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
extraCost.title: Or

stratagems.flavor: The thick armour and thicker skulls of Nobz make them a daunting prospect to gun down.
stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.flavor: With bone‐headed arrogance, Nobz will carry on killing before their deaths finally dawn on them.
stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ If your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, re-roll **hit rolls**.
stratagems.flavor: Nobz load themselves with all manner of weapons in shows of wealth and influence.
stratagems.name: Armed To Da Teef
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

enhancements.body: BEAST SNAGGA model only. When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.
enhancements.flavor: When bigger prey is sighted, nothing can keep this hunter from it. With a roar of glee, lesser gitz are swiftly forgotten in his enthusiasm to pile into a greater challenge.
enhancements.name: Glory Hog

enhancements.body: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. This model has +1 **[gloss:toughness:T]**.
enhancements.flavor: The monstrous resilience – and odour – of this Beastboss’ hulking mount has inspired many lurid tales of its origin.
enhancements.name: It Came from da Drops

rule.body: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units’ attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
rule.flavor: Beast Snaggas fanatically hunt the biggest targets and are experts in finding their weak spots.
rule.name: Da Hunt is On

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
stratagems.flavor: With a keen eye for tracking their prey, Beast Snaggas will circle around to ambush the luckless gitz from another angle.
stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that enemy unit must use the **[gloss:desperate-escape:desperate escape] **mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]** for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is **engaged** with, with -1 from those **hazard rolls** if that enemy unit is **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**.
stratagems.flavor: Beast Snagga victims often make a break for it before the Orks have tired of fighting. Hooked, impaled or ridden down, few survive such flight.
stratagems.name: Where D’ya Fink You’re Going?
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that enemy unit is **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6". If your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, it can re-roll that D6.
stratagems.flavor: Should attempts to obliterate the Beast Snaggas from afar fail, it is often the foe’s last mistake as the hunters turn their baleful attention on them.
stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

enhancements.body: BIG MEK/MEK model only. This model has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
enhancements.flavor: This Mek’s extra bioniks help him keep up with his Kans.
enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta

enhancements.body:
BIG MEK model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding BIG MEK units):
▪ This model has [core:Lone Operative].
▪ In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model. That unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1 until the end of the turn.
enhancements.flavor: This Mek is deft at avoiding his creations’ feet and klaws.
enhancements.name: Dreadherder

rule.body:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units) is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit’s attacks have the relevant rule(s):
▪ **1-2:** +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**
▪ **3-4:** +2 **[gloss:strength:S]**
▪ **5-6:** +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**

If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard roll]**.
rule.flavor: Inviting Mek-wired buttons offer varied and erratic lethality.
rule.name: Try Dat Button!

stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.flavor: A pilot’s single-mindedness and his walker’s durable form mean few obstacles can impede its relentless stomping advance.
stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]** or **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.

stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.flavor: Even horrific damage will not prevent many Ork combat walkers from crunching and stomping their enemies in a final fugue of psychotic aggression.
stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).

stratagems.effect: Your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]** until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.flavor: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis – and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz – it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.
stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

enhancements.body:
ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only.
▪ This unit has CHARACTER.
▪ When this unit ends an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6" of this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]** until the start of your next turn.
enhancements.flavor: Brutish aces who have survived enough dogfights to rise to positions of superiority, Flybosses inspire other Ork aviators to heights of psychotic enthusiasm.
enhancements.name: Flyboss (Upgrade)

enhancements.body: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**.
enhancements.flavor: Despite claims of scoutin’, this aircraft’s screaming dive ahead of its pilot’s mates is purely for the thrill of attacking first.
enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon (Upgrade)

rule.body:
▪ Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points value of your **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]** units.
▪ While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
rule.flavor: When attacking en masse, crazed and excitable Flyboyz unleash torrential quantities of dakka.
rule.name: Skyborne Loons

stratagems.effect: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.
stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6".
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.
stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit does not have the [core:Deadly Demise] ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:
▪ For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**. Then remove your unit from the battlefield.
stratagems.flavor: Some Ork pilots, out of bullets and out of luck, brighten up considerably when they realise their own aircraft is a deadly weapon in its own right.
stratagems.name: Flyin’ Headbutt
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, before rolling for any [core:Deadly Demise].

enhancements.body: BOYZ unit only. This unit has 4+ **[gloss:save:Sv]**.
enhancements.flavor: Orks with enough teef – or muscle – can acquire extra scrap iron plates collectively referred to as ‘eavy armour, which is battered into shape so that it roughly fits the wearer.
enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz (Upgrade)

enhancements.body:
ORKS INFANTRY model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
▪ __Or:__ If this unit has 11+ models, +2 **A**.
enhancements.flavor: This brutal fighter is even more dangerous with a raucous audience of chanting Orks, as he displays his violent abilities as a warning to all.
enhancements.name: Ferocious Show-off

rule.body:
▪ Friendly BOYZ units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
▪ If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: NON-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
rule.flavor: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
rule.name: Mob-handed Brutality

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
stratagems.flavor: When da Boyz get stuck into the foe, the carnage is wonderful to behold, at least for all their mates.
stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock rolls]** are automatically successful.
stratagems.flavor: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.target: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.
stratagems.when: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Orks can put on a surprising turn of speed when the promise of a good face‐to‐face fight is in the offing.
stratagems.name: ’Ere We Go
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.

enhancements.body: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit can re‑roll **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: This Speedboss despises the thought of coming anything less than first in a race to reach the biggest fights.
enhancements.name: Competitive Streak

enhancements.body: SPEED FREEKS unit only (excluding AIRCRAFT units). When an attack targets a unit that is not **[gloss:fully-visible:fully visible]** to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the **[gloss:benefit-of-cover:benefit of cover]** against that attack.
enhancements.flavor: These loud, fume-belching devices wreathe those in the Speed Freeks’ wake in a thick bank of obscuring smoke.
enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz (Upgrade)

rule.body:
▪ Friendly WARBIKERS units have BATTLELINE.
▪ When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**:
▪ That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
▪ That move does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.
rule.flavor: After smashing into the foe at full tilt, a Speed Freek will pull hairpin turns to do it all again.
rule.name: Adrenaline Junkies

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.flavor: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]** of 1‑3.
stratagems.flavor: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.
stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.

stratagems.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** 3 wounds.
stratagems.flavor: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.
stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

enhancements.body:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. When this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is **infested with Snotlings** until the start of your next turn.
▪ While an enemy unit is **infested with Snotlings**, that unit has -1 to **[gloss:leadership-roll:leadership rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: These kustom jobs incorporate an oversized suction device, drawing in nearby runts aplenty, as well as Squigs, loose scrap, and even poorly fastened pieces of the gun itself. The Mek’s targets – those that survive – end up infested with countless screeching Snotlings.
enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw (Upgrade)

enhancements.body: BIG MEK model only. This unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**.
enhancements.flavor: This Big Mek’s obsession with feverish inventing and his dreams of ludicrous technological destruction are infectious, inspiring other Orks to excitable aggression.
enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind

enhancements.body:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, you can roll one D6:
▪ On a 1, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [TORRENT], and when this unit has shot, this model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**.
▪ On a 2-5, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
▪ On a 6, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [SUSTAINED HITS 2].
enhancements.flavor: Shokk attack guns are notoriously unreliable, and even with a supposedly enhanced set of worky bits, this Big Mek is never certain what will happen when he sets the thing off.
enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka (Upgrade)

rule.body:
In your Shooting phase, when all of a friendly BIG MEK/MEK GUNZ/MORKANAUT/WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit's ranged attacks target a single enemy unit, roll one D6:
▪ **1 — Dat's Weird:** The target unit has 4+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]** until your unit has shot.
▪ **2-3 — Hop Splat:** Select one other enemy unit within 3" of the target. That unit suffers D3 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
▪ **4 — Seekerz:** Those attacks have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
▪ **5 — Lifted:** The target unit has FLY, and cannot have the **[gloss:benefit-of-cover:benefit of cover]**, until your unit has shot.
▪ **6 — Runtified:** The target unit has -1 **[gloss:toughness:T]** until your unit has shot.
rule.flavor: Meks haul all manner of weird bullets, unstable power cells and kustomised extras to battle.
rule.name: Unpredictable Genius

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
▪ __Or:__ [HAZARDOUS], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.flavor: Though cowardly, Grot artillery crews will dare to overcharge their weapons in acts of spectacular spite.
stratagems.name: Vindictive Artillerists
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

enhancements.body: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
enhancements.flavor: A lifetime of evading the attentions of Orks and even other runts has honed these Grots’ sneakiness to preternatural levels.
enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky (Upgrade)

enhancements.body: GRETCHIN unit only. While this unit is not embarked, this unit has [core:Scouts 6"].
enhancements.flavor: Rebellious, lazy or just plain unlucky Gretchin are driven into dangerous vanguard duties. These runts scarper forward with the hope of making it through as quickly as possible.
enhancements.name: Minefield Detail (Upgrade)

rule.body:
▪ Friendly GRETCHIN units have BATTLELINE.
▪ When a friendly GRETCHIN unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that move does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.
rule.flavor: Given no position of importance, Grots find their niche as sneaks, thieves and mischief-makers.
rule.name: Sneaky Little Gitz

stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6".
▪ __Or:__ Up to 6" instead if your unit is an **[gloss:attached-unit:attached]** unit.
stratagems.flavor: Through natural cowardice or a Runtherd’s threats, Grots’ agile reactions can leave foes flat-footed.
stratagems.name: Scarper!
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** GRETCHIN unit.

stratagems.effect:
When an enemy unit is making attacks, at the end of the Hit Rolls step, if those attacks target that ORKS INFANTRY unit, your opponent does the following:
▪ Select one hit.
▪ End the attack sequence for that hit.
▪ Your GRETCHIN unit suffers one **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

Your opponent repeats these steps until there are no hits to resolve, or until your GRETCHIN unit is destroyed (whichever happens first). When your GRETCHIN unit is destroyed, the attack sequence continues for any remaining hits.
stratagems.flavor: Despite their protestations, Gretchin make surprisingly effective bullet shields.
stratagems.name: Grot Shields
stratagems.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).

stratagems.effect: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** unit, in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**, at its **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]**, with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: Short, scrawny and skilled at hiding, there are usually a lot more Gretchin about than meets the eye.
stratagems.name: Infested War Zone
stratagems.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**. You can target that unit with this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** even though that unit was just **destroyed**.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.

enhancements.body:
ORKS INFANTRY model only (excluding WEIRDBOY models). This model’s ranged attacks have:
▪ [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+].
▪ [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
▪ [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]. [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]**:** Each time a unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make two **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]** for that unit for each [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon you selected in the Select Weapons step.
enhancements.flavor: The Mek who cobbled together this strange dakka accelerator isn’t sure exactly what it does – and it glows weirdly – but its new owner proudly carries it to battle, eager to know what its big switch will do this time.
enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing

enhancements.body: BIG MEK/BIGBOSS/WARBOSS model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [TORRENT] attacks) have +3" **[gloss:range:R]**.
enhancements.flavor: With a couple of these boggle-eyed varieties of Squigs on hand, even Ork shooting has a chance of hitting distant targets, helped by squinting really hard.
enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs

rule.body:
Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have:
▪ [ASSAULT].
▪ While this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, +3" **[gloss:range:R]**.
rule.flavor: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
rule.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.name: Kustom Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
stratagems.flavor: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.name: Glowin’ Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.flavor: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.name: Never Enough Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

enhancements.body:
BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. While this model is part of an **[gloss:attached-unit:attached]** unit, this model has:
▪ [core:Infiltrators].
▪ [core:Stealth].
enhancements.flavor: Possessed of exceptional kunnin’ and a weird obsession with sneakin’ about, this powerful Ork leader loves nothing more than creeping through enemy defences before carving a bloody path through their lines.
enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda

enhancements.body: KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: NON-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
enhancements.flavor: Veterans of the relatively organised butchery of well-protected targets, these distrusted Orks make excellent forward assassins.
enhancements.name: Throat-slittas (Upgrade)

rule.body:
▪ Friendly STORMBOYZ units have BATTLELINE.
▪ When a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.
rule.flavor: An un-Orky compulsion for discipline can wrongfoot enemies expecting anarchic disorder.
rule.name: Suspiciously Well Organised

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.
stratagems.name: While Their Backs are Turned
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** at the start of the phase.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.
stratagems.flavor: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.
stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:objective:objective]** your unit is controlling. That **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**.
stratagems.flavor: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.
stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.when: Start/end of your Movement phase.

enhancements.body: ORKS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Movement phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]** until the start of your next turn.
enhancements.flavor: This war leader is a glowering incarnation of violence, his brutality so contagious that when he bellows his blind fury and releases his pent-up aggression, Orks nearby are excitedly swept along with him.
enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'

enhancements.body: ORKS model only. This unit has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
enhancements.flavor: Always found at the forefront of an assault, this Ork likes to be the first into the fray with his mob close on his heels to join in the violence.
enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz

enhancements.body: ORKS model only. If this unit made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
enhancements.flavor: Tribal legend speaks of a blood-slick choppa once owned by Grand Warboss Headwoppa – last seen charging headlong into a horde of daemons – that turns up occasionally across the galaxy in different forms. Though it looks normal, a dark voice is said to growl in the mind of the weapon’s wielder, driving them on to ever greater excesses of violence.
enhancements.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa

enhancements.body: ORKS model only. When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]/[gloss:declare-charge:declare a charge]**.
enhancements.flavor: Feigning weakness, this Ork allows his foes to think he’s legging it before suddenly piling back into the fight and delivering a brutal flurry of attacks.
enhancements.name: Kunnin’ But Brutal

rule.body: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
rule.flavor: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
rule.name: Get Stuck In

stratagems.effect:
Roll one D3:
▪ Your unit suffers a number of **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]** equal to the result.
▪ Your unit is no longer **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]**.
stratagems.flavor: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.name: Breakin’ Heads
stratagems.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** even though it is **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly **[gloss:attached-unit:attached]** ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ [RAPID FIRE 1].
▪ __Or:__ If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).
stratagems.flavor: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.name: Close-range Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.flavor: So resilient is Ork physiology – and so slow are Orks on the uptake – even death can take time to register.
stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks have:
▪ [CLEAVE 1].
▪ __Or:__ If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).
stratagems.flavor: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.
stratagems.name: Mow ’Em Down
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
stratagems.flavor: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek‐built engine.
stratagems.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
stratagems.flavor: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.name: Hit ’Em Harder
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.

enhancements.body: BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ORKS INFANTRY units. When doing so, you can set those units up in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**, regardless of how many units are already in **strategic reserves**.
enhancements.flavor: This impressively ostentatious piece of headgear signifies that whoever nicked it last controls a fleet of kroozers and invasion landers, ideal for the rapid redeployment of loot-hungry Orks.
enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat

enhancements.body: FLASH GITZ unit only. This unit’s Snazzgun weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1].
enhancements.flavor: Coils of sparking wires, unstable propellant and throbbing power cells are just some of the extras which Flash Gitz rivet onto their snazzguns to kill the enemy in more over-the-top ways.
enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka (Upgrade)

rule.body:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, if any of the following apply, that unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1:
▪ That unit is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
▪ The target of that attack is within range of an **objective**.
rule.flavor: Whether piratical or merely larcenous, Orks with an eye for loot react forcefully to rival claims.
rule.name: Wreckin’ and Lootin’

stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using **[gloss:normal-shooting:normal shooting]**, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.flavor: With a snort of contempt, these Orks decide to show the gitz who just shot at them what real guns are capable of.
stratagems.name: Gun-crazy Show-offs
stratagems.target: One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the [core:Firing Deck] ability have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Ork transports are not the smoothest of rides. However, the best loot-hunters have honed their drive-by volleys of armour-cracking firepower to the point of deadly accuracy.
stratagems.name: Drive-By Bustin’
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
▪ Your unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: Wreckin’ some gitz is all well and good, but getting the drop on them and then grabbing an opportunity for some loot is even better.
stratagems.name: Grab It
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.

enhancements.body: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has the following weapon:
enhancements.flavor: Roiling energies frequently erupt from this Weirdboy’s eyes, solidifying above the enemy into the huge green foot of Gork (or Mork) himself, which repeatedly stamps on the foe.
enhancements.name: Da Krunch

enhancements.body: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has the following weapon:
enhancements.flavor: Known for yelling ‘Kop dis, ya zogger!’ at his chosen target beforehand, this Weirdboy is in the habit of projecting a bolt of raw power from his forehead which splatters the victim’s brains across a wide area.
enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger

enhancements.body:
ORKS PSYKER model only. This model:
▪ Has **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level 2]**.
▪ Has [core:Deadly Demise D6].
▪ Can re-roll **[gloss:psychic-roll:psychic rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: Where most Weirdboyz would quite like to be left alone, so-called Warpheads become addicted to the danger, intentionally supercharging their tortured minds and revelling in venting dangerously unpredictable powers.
enhancements.name: Warphead

rule.body:
Friendly ORKS PSYKER models’ [PSYCHIC] attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.
▪ +1 **S** for every 5 models in this unit (or embarked within this model).

Friendly ORKS PSYKER models have the following **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic abilities]**:

**Roar of Mork (psychic level 1):** In your Movement phase, if this unit is not **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**, you can make a **[gloss:psychic-roll:psychic roll]** for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
▪ On a 1, this unit is **battle-shocked**.
▪ Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 from that **battle-shock roll** for every 10 models in this unit.

**Visions of Violence (psychic level 1):** At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not **battle-shocked**, you can make a **psychic roll** for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
▪ On a 1, this unit is **battle-shocked**.
▪ This unit has [core:Fights First].
rule.flavor: Surrounded by mobs of excitable Orks, Weirdboyz’ shamanic powers build to spectacular phenomena.
rule.name: Powers of da Waaagh!
